typescriptAllowlist.name: typescript
typescriptAllowlist.reason: dependency-cruiser's tsc extractor (.dependency-cruiser.cjs parser "tsc") loads the TypeScript 6 compiler API to tag type-only imports; the same install serves the vue-tsc peer in packages/vue and packages/playground-vue, the classic projects of the compiler-work budget and the packaged-consumer compile in scripts/validate-dist.ts.

rustExceptions.reason: cargo-hawk requires Rust 1.97.1; remove when Hawk supports the shared Rust pin.

dependabotIgnores.reason: The VS Code extension's engine floor: plugins/vscode/scripts/check-engine-floor.ts requires engines.vscode to equal ^<@types/vscode>, so raising it drops older editors and is a deliberate change.
tsdown 0.23.2 brings rolldown-plugin-dts 0.29.0-beta.2, whose declaration build needs the TypeScript 7.1 beta; tsdown moves with the pinned TypeScript, which Dependabot also leaves alone.
